title: Amazon Announces Melania Trump Prime Video Series
excerpt: Amazon is releasing a two-part Prime Video series about the first lady titled Melania: The Series, scheduled to debut on November 20th.
body_html:
Amazon is expanding its content regarding the first lady with a newly announced two-part Prime Video series titled Melania: The Series. Following a documentary movie that premiered earlier in the year, this upcoming show is scheduled to make its debut on November 20th.

According to the promotional description, the series aims to share never-before-told stories and provide unprecedented insight into the life of Melania Trump, highlighting various days from her experiences.
